hypothesis: The default locking provider is in-memory, so the cart lock in complete-cart only serializes within one server process. Completing the same cart simultaneously on two servers lets both pass the lock and both create an order (or conflict on reservations), breaking one-order-per-cart or leaving orphaned or missing orders.

hypothesis: createReservationItems_ reads the level and then writes reserved_quantity = old read + adjustment without a row lock or atomic increment. Many carts for the same WIDGET completing concurrently on two servers (the in-memory lock doesn't span them) interleave read and write, losing updates: reserved_quantity ends below the sum of live reservations, and the availability check can pass too, causing oversell.
